reviews.author: Steven D.
reviews.text: I can not recommend more! We just moved into the area and we're experiencing sewage problems in our new house - they were lightening fast, very professional and explained everything as it happened. The price was fair and they even came back the next day when we experienced more problems. I won't be using ANYONE else for my future plumbing needs!! They definitely gained a lifelong customer!

reviews.author: Brittany Perkinson
reviews.text: I couldn’t be more satisfied! I spoke with Billy at 9:30 at night with a plumbing issue I had! I was able to tell him what was going on over the phone and he helped me diagnose the problem but his customer service didn’t stop there! He even made a few phone calls for me and had someone coming to my house that night! I will NEVER use a different plumbing company and I WILL ALWAYS recommend them! They are an amazing group of individuals who have outstanding customer service and by far the most professional, truthful and reliable work around! Thanks so much Lil Bill’s for going above and beyond!!! Y’all are a life saver!!!

reviews.author: Jesse Guerrette
reviews.text: Amazing service! I called the night before, they showed up bright and early the next day and did a fantastic job repairing my water heater, and their prices are extremely reasonable.

reviews.author: allyson allen
reviews.text: Billy is a genuine nice guy who really cares about his customers. He was able to send someone at the last minute to my grandparents house after a week of well issues and help them w their water in the home after the well was fixed. Honest, fair pricing. Highly recommend over and over!

reviews.author: Angel Stevens
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing. I called him at midnight cause the great reviews on google, and he lived up to all of it. Friendly, went above and beyond and the price was beyond far. I won’t use anyone in from here on out and I will recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Rhonda Taylor
reviews.text: Thank you for the prompt service. The tech was knowledgeable and found the leak without my crazy theories about what was wrong. Service and replacement parts were reasonably priced. Locally owned and operated.

reviews.author: Debra Fleming
reviews.text: My pipes backed up 2 days before I was supposed to go out of town for Thanksgiving. I called Lil Bills and they came out right away and fixed problem. Thank you so much for helping me. I will definitely recommend your services to others.Jeff was great and worked hard to fix problem. Thx so much!!

reviews.author: Carol Betzler
reviews.text: This was an emergency situation. For hopewell humane society on Oaklawn Blve. He came within 20 minutes. His personnel were courteous and knowledgeable. Situation corrected promptly. Very positive interactions. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Natalie Lambert
reviews.text: Bill came out when my father passed away to unclog pipe and fix a backed up line. He was so kind and didn’t even charge us! Great, sweet guy and great service!!

reviews.author: Wayne Davis
reviews.text: I called and in less than 2 hours someone was there. They were very professional and kind. I will recommend them to everyone and they will get my business from now on.

reviews.author: Rosemarie May
reviews.text: Great service. Very knowledgeable and so quick to solve my plumbing problems. Ive known Bill for years and trust him with all my plumbing and repair issues

reviews.author: Pat Antom
reviews.text: Fast efficient and friendly. . . . Now I can take a shower thanks guys highly recommended #supportlocals
